scope: New conditional bridge public packet and named public application changes; no private implementation or unrelated local data searched/copied
manual_attribution_review: Reviewed mathematical providers remain attributed to dot/pinned published source packets; new contribution is implementation, generic formalization, exact replay and provenance repair. privacy_limits: A bounded pattern scan supplements content/source review; it is not proof that all possible sensitive data forms are absent. All evidence comes from authorized public sources, synthetic fixtures and local generated checks.
